Guaranteed renewal is up to age 85; cover does not continue beyond that.

trends.whatProductOffers: At three defined milestone events the client can buy an additional term add-on without further health information: taking out a mortgage on a new residential property, marriage, or the birth of a natural child.

keyFigures.label: Trigger events
keyFigures.value: New residential mortgage drawdown / marriage / birth of a natural child

keyFigures.label: Frequency cap
keyFigures.value: Once per milestone event and any two milestone events for the same insured

keyFigures.label: Minimum spacing
keyFigures.value: At least 2 consecutive years between purchases

keyFigures.label: Deadline
keyFigures.value: Within 180 days of the milestone event
keyFigures.condition: and on or before the anniversary after age 60

keyFigures.label: Max sum assured per add-on
keyFigures.value: Lower of US$250,000 or HK$/MOP1,875,000; 50% of this plan's sum assured; or the mortgage loan amount

keyFigures.label: Conversion privilege
keyFigures.value: Convert to whole life without further health information
keyFigures.condition: on or before the anniversary after age 70

exclusionsOrConditions: No claim may have been submitted or paid under the policy at the time of exercise.
The new add-on is subject to underwriting requirements determined by the company.
The mortgage trigger applies only to a new purchase of residential property, not refinancing.
The birth trigger excludes adoption.
Sum assured per add-on is capped at the lowest of the three limits stated.
The conversion privilege is subject to increased premium and to the products then available.
